overviewParagraphs: Lake View Resort & Golf Club is Hua Hin's most diverse golfing proposition — a 36-hole facility structured across four distinct nine-hole loops (Mountain, Lake, Desert, and Links) that each deliver a genuinely different playing character and aesthetic experience. For golfers visiting Hua Hin on extended programs, Lake View's ability to provide several rounds of genuinely varied golf makes it an exceptional value proposition.

The Mountain nine uses the surrounding hill terrain for elevation interest and panoramic views. The Lake nine is the most visually striking — water is the dominant design element throughout, with multiple island hole and approach-over-water demands. The Desert nine adopts a firmer, more arid aesthetic inspired by American desert-style courses. The Links nine uses open, wind-exposed terrain to evoke coastal links character without formally fronting the sea.

For international golf groups in Hua Hin looking for multiple rounds without repetition, AGS frequently structures programs pairing Black Mountain with two Lake View combinations — the dramatic granite drama of Black Mountain balanced by the variety and value of Lake View across two 18-hole visits using different nine combinations each time.

curatorBriefHtml: Lake View Resort & Golf Club is a premier Par 72 (any 18 combination) championship layout in Hua Hin, Thailand, crafted by Roger Packard (1993) and stretching to 6,550 Yards (Blue Tees) across a multiple terrain styles — variety of character environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its 36 holes (mountain, lake, desert, links) (Four distinct nines) and desert course waste bunkering (Arid cactus & sand hazards).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Lake View Resort & Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its traditional thai caddie service (Experienced and helpful), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hua Hin golf tour by AGS, Lake View Resort & Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Roger Packard that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: A comprehensive 36-hole facility near Hua Hin. Features four distinct nine-hole experiences: Mountain, Lake, Desert, and Links, offering great variety for multi-round societies.
